displayName: GHADV-2098: Armeria: External Control of File Name or Path in xDS SDS DataSource
description:

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_other_ghadv_2098", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%armeria%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%external%') AND "value" > 0
